root_idea.summary: The securely matched lexical branch centers on refusal of obedience: withholding compliance and opposing an authority.
root_idea.development: A shared discussion relates عِصْيَان to departing from obedience and figuratively to withholding oneself; its separate عَصَا “staff” material is not assigned here as a direct meaning of this root.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form عَصَى.
Displayed as the distinct intensive adjective عَصِيّ.
Displayed as the distinct verbal noun عِصْيَان.
Displayed under the normalized citation form مَعْصِيَة.

senses.definition: To disobey, oppose, or rebel against an authority; to fail to obey.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for refusal of compliance with a person, command, or authority, whether or not the object is expressed.
An intensive epithet relative to عَاصٍ; it may function adjectivally or substantivally.

senses.definition: Disobedience or rebellion; the contrary of obedience.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun or simple substantive naming the condition or act of refusing obedience.
A noun of the disobedience branch, referring to noncompliance with an authority or command.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To face the quarter from which the wind blows, presenting one’s front rather than one’s side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed tropical usage, in the construction عَصَى الرِّيحَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an affair, to be or become difficult.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an affair or matter that proves difficult.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feign disobedience or rebellion; to manifest noncompliance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived Form VI usage describing displayed or pretended incompliance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a date-stone, to be or become hard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction اِعْتَصَتِ النَّوَاةُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who disobeys or rebels; disobedient or rebellious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The ordinary active-participial term, distinguished from the intensive عَصِيّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young camel that disobeys its mother and does not follow her.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized appellation explicitly applied to a young camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vein that will not cease bleeding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical lexical usage; the cited plural is العَوَاصِي.

cautions: The Quranic عَصِيّ is treated separately from the Classical headword عَاصٍ because the supplied lexical evidence describes عَصِيّ as the intensive epithet.
The supplied Mufradat entry is shared between ESw and ESy and combines staff-related and disobedience-related material; its staff branch is therefore not used as a direct Quranic sense here.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: mufradat:row:980 is a shared/composite entry assigned to both ESw and ESy. Its عَصَا “staff” and striking-with-sword material cannot be assigned uniquely to ESy, although its disobedience discussion is consistent with the independently supported Lane branch.
